en.frontmatter:
title: "Evolution of pretrained models: RoBERTa, ELECTRA, GPT-2 and ModernBERT"
description: "Four successors of BERT and GPT changed different parts of the pretraining recipe: RoBERTa the procedure and data, ELECTRA the objective, GPT-2 the data and scale, ModernBERT the architecture, data and implementation. The note separates these kinds of change and shows what each bought."
course: nlp
section: Pretrained Language Models
order: 21
status: published
tags: [roberta, electra, gpt-2, modernbert, pretraining, dynamic-masking, replaced-token-detection, zero-shot, encoder]
prerequisites: [BERT and masked language modeling, GPT and autoregressive language modeling, Positional representations]
headings: Baseline: the recipes of BERT and GPT
RoBERTa: the same network, trained differently
ELECTRA: a training signal at every position
GPT-2: the same objective at a larger scale
ModernBERT: an encoder rebuilt with a decoder's parts

ru.frontmatter:
title: "Эволюция предобученных моделей: RoBERTa, ELECTRA, GPT-2 и ModernBERT"
description: "Четыре наследника BERT и GPT изменили разные части рецепта предобучения: RoBERTa — процедуру и данные, ELECTRA — цель обучения, GPT-2 — данные и масштаб, ModernBERT — архитектуру, данные и реализацию. Заметка разделяет эти виды изменений и показывает, что дало каждое."
